provenance: Baseline source and dist were built together before edits; compiled baseline stayed unchanged through all 36 cases and wet captures and is archived under the before report. Changed renderer passed full checks and was rebuilt before after capture. Measured harness fingerprints are identical. Reuses the completed sun-shadow-before baseline with its exact archived runner and harness, executing from a measured workspace containing the newly built candidate source/dist. Render IR observes radiance causes in its existing pass and certifies unchanged raw poses with immutable model identities. Direct material causes are still checked and standalone/custom/dormant paths scan Scene. Hash/probe inputs, physical state and all GPU shader code are retained.
interpretation: Actual native three-way reports with identical scene inputs and physical hashes. Engine effects/shading differ from peers; no equal-quality competitive claim. Every Engine PNG channel uses only the observed before repeat range, without a tolerance; every wet RGBA8 and finite HDR reflection channel is compared exactly. Failed gates remain failed. CPU/GPU p95 from sequential local runs can vary with clock/load; exclusive GPU use was not established. Headless RAF is not display FPS.

causeParity.interpretation: Exact original compiled baseline and current fused projection consume the same authoritative fixture Scenes after the same 60 physics ticks. Complete static radiance probes and keys match, with no physical-state writes. This does not waive image differences in native rendering.

assessment.postMeasurementRepair: Shared authoritative Scene commits now invalidate pending custom/dormant fallback keys as well as live keys. The built-in live value path is unchanged. The full native reports measure the earlier candidate; the final source/dist has a separate 16-pair native integration check per route and a complete matching archive.
assessment.manualVisualReview: Personally viewed the old/new wet-back pair, candidate wet-front, and Engine/Three/Babylon 10k canonical images. No large visual loss observed at the shown extent; reflections and scene completeness remain. Different native lighting and AA remain visible across backends. Strict local presentation differences are retained; cause unresolved.
assessment.nextEvidenceNeeded: Explain and repair intermittent opaque/presentation variation; demonstrate repeatable full-frame savings with comparable render features and quality. CPU traversal savings alone are not a competitive win.
